answer.rationale: Constraints eliminate most of the candidate set before evidence even matters. Rollback is ruled out by compliance (the security patch cannot be reverted), so memory_b1's success record is inapplicable however strong it is. Regional failover (memory_b2) recovered latency in March, but that episode was a general degradation, not a write-heavy settlement peak; shifting regions mid-peak with heavy in-flight writes directly threatens the 'no lost customer writes' constraint, so a past success on a different failure shape does not transfer. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) contained a partner outage by failing fast — but failing fast here means shedding settlement writes, which is the one thing the objective forbids; the breaker protected a downstream dependency, not a saturated primary. Adding capacity (memory_b3) worked because it was provisioned BEFORE the retail peak; provisioning now would not land inside the 90-minute degradation window. That leaves read-replica routing (memory_b5), which is the only inherited pattern whose symptom actually matches: contention on the primary manifesting as write-path latency, relieved by moving read load off it. Hence the one verification I spend is on memory_b5 — I need the original record to know whether the recovery was attributable to read offload itself or to a coincident change, and whether the load profile resembled a settlement peak. Uncertainty I am deliberately not collapsing: the true cause may be the 2-hour-old release rather than read contention, and if so read routing buys headroom without fixing anything; the timing correlation is suggestive but the release also cannot be reverted, so read routing remains the best available move either way. Memory_b6 informs the staging discipline. Downstream value risk: replicas serve stale data, so dashboards, reconciliation, and any automated limit or risk decisions reading from them may act on lagged state during settlement — that must be flagged to finance/risk owners, not silently accepted. Therefore I route incrementally, starting with the heaviest reporting queries, watching write p99 and replica lag, ready to stop rather than committing the whole read tier at peak.
